_comment: Curated AR domain reference: lighting models, physics body types, animation easings, shader modifier entry points. Edit here to update without code changes.

lighting_models.name: PBR
lighting_models.description: Physically Based Rendering. Realistic metal/dielectric materials using GGX BRDF.
lighting_models.when_to_use: Photorealistic surfaces: metal, plastic, leather, wood with proper texture maps.

lighting_models.name: Blinn
lighting_models.description: Blinn-Phong shading with diffuse + specular highlights. Cheaper than PBR.

lighting_models.name: Lambert
lighting_models.description: Pure diffuse (matte) shading, no specular component.

lighting_models.name: Constant
lighting_models.description: No lighting calculation — the diffuse color/texture is rendered as-is.
lighting_models.when_to_use: UI overlays, glow effects, unlit objects, particle emitter materials.

physics_body_types.name: Static
physics_body_types.description: Infinite mass, never moves. Other bodies collide against it.

physics_body_types.name: Dynamic
physics_body_types.description: Affected by gravity and forces. Reacts to collisions.
physics_body_types.when_to_use: Falling objects, projectiles, anything that should respond to physics.

physics_body_types.name: Kinematic
physics_body_types.description: Moves only when you tell it to (via animations / explicit position changes). Not affected by physics but other Dynamic bodies bounce off it.
physics_body_types.when_to_use: Moving platforms, animated obstacles, scripted hazards.

shader_modifier_entry_points.name: Geometric
shader_modifier_entry_points.purpose: Modify vertex positions, normals before geometry pass.

shader_modifier_entry_points.name: Surface
shader_modifier_entry_points.purpose: Modify surface properties (diffuse color, normal, roughness).
